channel.title: TLV Revision Podcasts
channel.description: Deep-dive podcasts for City & Guilds T Level Management and Administration.

item.title: Deep dive 6.1: From TOWS matrix to boardroom briefing
item.description: Deep dive for topic 6.1 (Lessons 1B, 2A and 2B). - Using PESTLE to feed external opportunities and threats into a SWOT. - Building the TOWS matrix: SO, WO, ST and WT strategies. - Turning the analysis into evidence-based recommendations for a board.

item.title: Deep dive 6.2: Why small daily changes beat massive restructures
item.description: Deep dive for topic 6.2 (Lesson 3A). - The Kaizen philosophy and standard work as the baseline. - Running the PDCA cycle (Plan, Do, Check, Act) with measurable KPIs. - Preventing operational bottlenecks.
item.itunes:summary: Deep dive for topic 6.2 (Lesson 3A). - The Kaizen philosophy and standard work as the baseline. - Running the PDCA cycle (Plan, Do, Check, Act) with measurable KPIs. - Preventing operational bottlenecks.

item.title: Deep dive 6.2: How continuous improvement prevents business crises
item.description: Deep dive for topic 6.2 (Lesson 3B). - Total Quality Management: customer focus and zero defects. - Psychological safety: admitting errors without blame. - The limits of small improvements during sudden structural crises.
item.itunes:summary: Deep dive for topic 6.2 (Lesson 3B). - Total Quality Management: customer focus and zero defects. - Psychological safety: admitting errors without blame. - The limits of small improvements during sudden structural crises.

item.title: Deep dive 6.3: Choosing between Kotter and Lewin
item.description: Deep dive for topic 6.3 (Lesson 4A). - Lewin's 3 stages: unfreeze, change, refreeze. - Kotter's 8 sequential steps. - Which fits small changes and which fits large-scale transformation.
item.itunes:summary: Deep dive for topic 6.3 (Lesson 4A). - Lewin's 3 stages: unfreeze, change, refreeze. - Kotter's 8 sequential steps. - Which fits small changes and which fits large-scale transformation.

item.title: Deep dive 6.3: Diagnosing employee resistance to change
item.description: Deep dive for topic 6.3 (Lesson 4B). - The root fears behind staff pushback. - Kotter and Schlesinger's six approaches: education, participation, facilitation, negotiation, manipulation, coercion.
item.itunes:summary: Deep dive for topic 6.3 (Lesson 4B). - The root fears behind staff pushback. - Kotter and Schlesinger's six approaches: education, participation, facilitation, negotiation, manipulation, coercion.

item.title: Deep dive 6.4: PRINCE2 versus Agile
item.description: Deep dive for topic 6.4 (Lesson 7A). - PRINCE2: controlled stages, the project board, business justification and managing by exception. - Agile: short iterations, customer collaboration and changing requirements. - Which methodology suits which kind of project.
